name: android_get_device_stats
description: Reads one kind of device data: device (model, Android version, screen, battery %), battery (level, temperature, health, charger), network (IP, Wi-Fi SSID, link speed), cpu (top processes or one package), memory (PSS and heaps of a package), gfx (frame and jank stats of a package).

package.description: Required for memory and gfx; optional for cpu.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
